title: [AUG-157] Add "Check for Updates" item to sidebar hamburger menu
why_we_need_this: The app's auto-updater is currently only accessible through the system tray menu. Users who don't think to right-click the tray icon have no way to manually trigger an update check or see that an update is ready. Adding the item to the sidebar ≡ menu (the primary in-app navigation) makes it discoverable.
acceptance_criteria:
- [ ] New "Check for Updates" menu item in the sidebar hamburger dropdown (below Settings, above the tooltip_missing link)
- [ ] Clicking it triggers `checkNow()` on the main-process updater via IPC
- [ ] The item label reflects the current UpdateState: "Check for Updates" (idle/error), "Checking for Updates…" (checking, disabled), "Downloading Update v{version} ({percent}%)…" (downloading, disabled), "Restart to Update to v{version}" (ready, triggers installNow)
- [ ] State changes push from main → renderer so the label updates in real time (download progress, ready state)
- [ ] In non-desktop mode (browser-only dev), the menu item is hidden — no broken click handler
- [ ] Both macOS and Windows behave identically
- [ ] Preload, desktop.d.ts, and SessionList.tsx stay in sync
important_constraints:
- Reuse the existing `UpdateState` type from `electron/src/updater.ts` — do not duplicate the state machine
- IPC channel naming follows the existing `august:` prefix convention
- The menu item must be a no-op guard when `window.august` is undefined (browser dev mode)
- Follow the brutalist design: 0 border-radius, existing `sidebar-menu-item` CSS class, stagger animation index
